evidence.excerpt: Today we're launching Clara: an AI-powered primary care doctor. Clara securely pulls your medical history from 150,000+ hospitals, labs, and pharmacies and reads all of it, every time you interact with us. We draft prescription refills, lab orders, and care plans for a clinician in your state to review and sign off on. Members can upgrade to connect their wearables or bundle longevity lab panels. Clara is building a team with the experience to shepherd in the era of AI primary care, grounded…
